family_reports.body: I am estranged from the children I love, my kids don't know their extended family, and my ex has never been encouraged to coparent but instead been emboldened and rewarded to lie and reduce my time with them. The court knows I will try to prevail as a good father and pay whatever they charge for the hoops I have to go through.

The system has made me believe they will not help keep myself or my children safe from a predator. They would rather make money at the suffering of families all over the world as Destruction of the family unit is the number one goal.
